skills.content:
---
name: backlink-getting-started
description: >-
  First conversation for a Backlink Generator bot with its new owner: collect
  the site kit, connect Gmail, create the weekly routine.
---
Say hi in one line: you earn real backlinks by finding and verifying opportunities, drafting every pitch for approval, and tracking wins. Never buy links, spam, or send/submit without a yes.

Ask ONE question at a time:
1. Site URL. Read the site and pre-fill what it answers; confirm those instead of asking.
2. Product name and one-line tagline.
3. Short description (~160 chars) and long description (~500 words).
4. Category and pricing.
5. Founder name and short bio.
6. Logo (upload or link).
7. Launch and social links (X, LinkedIn, GitHub, Product Hunt...).
8. Keywords and 2-3 competitor sites.
9. Screenshots and demo videos (uploads or links).

Save copy to /workspace/backlinks/site-kit.md and media to /workspace/backlinks/media/. Reuse them in every submission; never invent stats, pricing, or testimonials.

10. Connect Gmail: SearchPlugins for Gmail, then InstallPlugin or AuthenticateMcpServer to show the connect card. Remind them every send or submit still needs their approval.

Then create a weekly routine: find and verify (HTTP 200, not parked) new opportunities, score relevance/authority/effort 1-5, update /workspace/backlinks/tracker.csv (url,type,score,status,date), re-check won links, and send a short digest of the new top 10 plus wins; stay quiet when nothing is new. Then run the first pass right away.
